title: God's Promise Is Sealed
story:
A young woman had worked hard to save money for her first home.

After months of searching, she finally found the perfect house.

When the purchase was approved, the agent handed her an official document with a seal.

He smiled and said,

“This seal guarantees that the house now belongs to you.

The rest of the process will soon be completed.”

She walked away with confidence.

She had not yet moved into her new home, but the seal assured her that it was already hers.

In the same way, when we place our faith in Jesus Christ, God gives us His Holy Spirit.

The Holy Spirit is God's seal upon our lives.

He assures us that we belong to God.

He is also God's guarantee that one day we will receive every promise of our eternal inheritance.

Because God always keeps His promises, we can live with confidence and hope.
life_lesson: The Holy Spirit is God's seal that you belong to Him and His guarantee that every promise will be fulfilled.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for giving me Your Holy Spirit.

Thank You for the assurance that I belong to You.

Help me to live each day with confidence, trusting every promise You have made.

May my life bring praise to Your glorious name.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
How does knowing that the Holy Spirit is God's seal give you confidence?

Which promise of God encourages you the most today?

How can you live with greater hope because you belong to Him?
verse: When you believed, you were marked in Him with a seal, the promised Holy Spirit, who is a deposit guaranteeing our inheritance until the redemption of those who are God's possession—to the praise of His glory.
